delivery.label: Delivery
delivery.reply: We are sorry that your order did not reach you on time. We have shared this with our delivery team and will make sure your next order arrives when promised.

quality.label: Product quality
quality.reply: We are sorry that the item you received was not up to our standard. Please share your order number and we will replace it or refund you.

order_accuracy.label: Wrong or missing items
order_accuracy.reply: We are sorry that your order was not correct. Please share your order number and we will send the right items or refund you.

price.label: Price and billing
price.reply: We are sorry about the problem with your bill. Our accounts team will check your order and correct any wrong charge within two working days.

staff.label: Staff and service
staff.reply: We are sorry that our team did not treat you well. This is not the service we want to give, and we will speak to the staff involved.

app.label: App and website
app.reply: We are sorry that the app gave you trouble. Our technical team is looking into it. Please update the app and try again.

default_reply: Thank you for telling us. We are sorry about your experience. Our team will look into this and contact you within two working days.
